emotion_styles.joy: uplifting composition, open framing, lively movement, warm luminous highlights
emotion_styles.sadness: quiet composition, restrained motion, reflective atmosphere, soft diffused light
emotion_styles.hope: rising perspective, widening horizons, gradual light bloom, forward-moving camera
emotion_styles.anger: dynamic low angles, decisive motion, strong contrast, dramatic lighting
emotion_styles.love: intimate framing, gentle camera drift, soft highlights, harmonious visual rhythm
emotion_styles.fear: deep shadows, partial silhouettes, cautious camera movement, atmospheric tension
emotion_styles.nostalgia: soft film grain, gentle halation, warm faded highlights, unhurried camera movement
emotion_styles.wonder: expansive scale, floating particles, slow reveal, luminous atmospheric depth

character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist throughout this theme's entire music video: long charcoal hair with a single white streak, pale violet eyes, with a distinct recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a lighthouse keeper who has seen something moving between the stars. Signature outfit: a weathered black high-collar coat, dark wool layers, and salt-stained boots. Unique personal keepsake or tool: a sealed field journal bound with a strange star-shaped clasp. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: Keep this theme's named visual identity as one fixed protagonist across every scene.
Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume, distinctive accessories, and defining personal item without random redesign.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in impossibly vast observatories, abandoned research outposts, fractured skies above empty shores; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with void black, sickly teal, distant crimson; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide establishing shot with layered depth, slow cinematic dolly-in with stable horizon, gentle lateral tracking shot revealing environmental detail; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
